BrochureContent.Content: A most attractive two bedroom mid terrace house situated in the heart of cork city in this mature and much sought after residential location. The property is bright and spacious is in good condition thoughout and is ideally suited to a first time buyer or as an investment opportunity. The property is situated in close proximity to the emerging docklands and within walking distance of the city centre and all of its amenities and attractions to include various shopping centres, the famous english market, local shops, entertainment venues and a wide variety of bars & restaurants.
